title: Count Character Frequency
description: Given a string, count how many times each character occurs in the string.
input: A string whose character frequencies need to be counted.
output: The frequency of each character present in the given string.

examples.explanation: The character 'l' appears twice, while 'h', 'e', and 'o' each appear once.
The character 'a' appears twice, while 'j' and 'v' appear once.
The character 'p' appears twice, while the other characters appear once.

constraints: The input must be a valid string.

approaches.name: Using Character Frequency Map
approaches.description: Traverse the string and maintain the frequency of each character using a map. Increment the count whenever a character is encountered.
approaches.whenToUse: Use when you need to count occurrences of characters efficiently and store the frequency of each distinct character.

interviewTips: Understand how HashMap stores a character as a key and its frequency as the value.
Know how to update an existing character count.
Be prepared to explain why the solution requires O(k) extra space, where k is the number of distinct characters.
Clarify whether uppercase and lowercase characters should be treated as different characters.
